title: Run 3
description: Changes many blocks and items to different tile types and icons from the hit Flash game Run 3. Oh, yeah, and music discs too.
body:
A resource pack that changes many blocks and items to resemble the hit Flash game Run 3. This is *technically* for 1.21.8, but it should work in most versions (I think. I don't know. I've never made a texture pack before).
- Various concrete blocks are changed to match iconic levels from the Main Tunnel.
- Other blocks are changed to match other tile types (like Crumbling, Ice, and more!)
- Some music discs have been changed to play the music from Run 3.
- Various items have been retextured based on what matched them best. (Do you like candy?)
- There are new textures for unknown servers and resource packs.
- There is 1 new splash text (All of the vanilla ones still exist, so it's kind of rare)
- The End Poem may or may not be replaced with something else...
- Blocks and items have been renamed to match their new textures.
  
**This pack should only be used in Creative mode!** A lot of naturally spawning blocks have been retextured, so they may look odd in a survival world. But if you want to build something cool and/or silly with them in creative mode, go ahead!
